csv_project_name: AE for Lopez Island Library Reroof Project
csv_scope_of_work: Lopez Island Library Pistrict seeks Statements of Qualhfications OQs from qualified Architectural/Engineering firms for design and construction adrainistration services for the Lopez Island Library Reroof Project. The primary goal of this project is to replace the failing roof system on the 7,624-sf building. The core objectives are: Eliminate active and potential water intrusion. Extend the lifespan of the building envelope. Improve energy efficiency and occupant comfort. Enhance fire resilience given the proximity to heavily wooded areas. Preserve the character, form, aesthetics and visual identity of the existing building.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
title: AE for Lopez Island Library Reroof Project
short_description: Design and construction administration for reroofing an existing public library building.
project_scope: Reroof project for the existing 7,624 sq ft Lopez Island Library building. The project aims to replace the failing roof system, eliminate active and potential water intrusion, extend the building envelope lifespan, improve energy efficiency and occupant comfort, enhance fire resilience due to nearby wooded areas, and preserve the existing building's character, form, aesthetics, and visual identity.
services: Architectural and engineering design services and construction administration; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, civil engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale reroofing project for an existing 7,624 sq ft library building.
- Primarily a building envelope replacement, not a structurally complex or long-span structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but no indication of innovative structural systems or significant spans.
- Sustainability-related aspects such as energy efficiency and fire resilience add minor relevance.
- Public building work is generally of some interest, but this project is limited in scale and technical ambition.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. Available scope information: reroofing of an existing 7,624 sq ft library building with goals including roof replacement, water intrusion mitigation, energy efficiency improvement, fire resilience enhancement, and preservation of the building's appearance. A realistic cost estimate is not reliable from the provided information alone because roof type, extent of structural repairs, materials, and local market conditions are not specified.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender documents. The procurement is for design and construction administration services for a reroof project, but the scope, service phases, and construction budget are insufficient to derive a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications requested from qualified architectural/engineering firms. Specific minimum reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided text.
